{{Top|leg}}
'''Halyard 2''' was a planet known for its [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Shipyard/Legends|factory]] operated by the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]]. During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], the factory produced light [[Transport/Legends|transports]]. Several hundred prototypes models of [[HWK-1000 light freighter]]s once disappeared from the factory due to a clerical error.<ref name="FC">''[[Fly Casual]]''</ref>
